title: Read quest's terminal statuses from quest task status-flow instead of hardcoding Done (QCLI-331 adds a second terminal status)
description: Filed on opum-agent's dispatch (OPAG-665 AC3, 2026-09-28). ADR read by ref: opum-doc docs/adr/add-a-second-terminal-task-status-for-duplicate-superseded-and-wont-do-outcomes.md at 724fc0959f0b (blob 650c6ea5). quest-cli QCLI-331 adds a second terminal task status with a required resolution (duplicate, superseded, wont-do). Wherever lore reads quest task status to decide completion (Story/Task coupling, lore check, bridges), a hardcoded Done would treat a task closed as duplicate/superseded/wont-do as still open. MEASURE FIRST: count the sites hardcoding Done as terminal, stating how many files were read, with a positive control; grep the bare word, classify after.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A measurement is recorded on this task BEFORE any code change: sites in src/ (and scripts/; test fixtures classified separately) that treat "Done" as the only terminal quest status, with the number of files read, the search used, and a positive control

Every completion decision lore makes from quest task status reads terminalStatuses from `quest task status-flow` (detected by capability presence, not a version comparison), with a stated fallback when the installed quest predates it
A test proves a task in the new terminal status is treated as complete by Story/Task coupling and lore check, and a non-terminal status is not

The adapter accepts a status-flow whose terminalStatuses is a subset of statuses plus closedStatus (quest-cli QCLI-331 shape B, and QCLI-406 later step A), and classifies closedStatus as terminal. A terminal status outside both is still drift, and that drift message names a lore/quest version MISMATCH, not "Quest 0.2.7 or newer is required", which is wrong for a too-new quest. Tests cover shape B (closedStatus present, terminalStatuses [Done]), shape A (terminalStatuses [Done, Closed]) and a genuinely foreign terminal status
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; reviewer pass

plan: 1. AC1: measure bare-word Done in src/ and scripts/ (and test/ separately) with /usr/bin/grep -rnw, count files read, positive control in src/adapters/quest.ts; record as a note and commit before code.

2. Adapter (AC4): statusFlow() accepts terminalStatuses subset of statuses plus closedStatus (capability presence: key exists); closedStatus classified terminal; foreign terminal status is drift with a version-MISMATCH message.

3. AC2: route every completion decision found in step 1 through the adapter-provided terminal set; fallback for quest without closedStatus = terminalStatuses alone; quest without status-flow is already rejected by the manifest probe.

4. AC3: tests that Closed is complete for Story/Task coupling and lore check, non-terminal is not; shape A/B/foreign adapter tests; mutation-test the tolerance; gates bun test, typecheck, lint, bun run lore check.
implementationNotes: RULING AND COUNTERPART (2026-09-28). quest-cli warned that QCLI-331 shape A (Closed inside terminalStatuses) breaks lore. lore-cli measured it by ref: the throw at src/adapters/quest.ts:681 ('Quest returned terminal statuses outside its status flow') is identical in tag v0.11.0 and, by git log -S, present since the fresh-history root e3d75867. It runs inside probe() (quest.ts:405), which ensure() calls before every quest adapter operation. So shape A with any published lore would break every tracker-touching command, and MIN_QUEST_VERSION 0.2.7 is a floor, not a ceiling. On that measurement opum-agent RE-RULED QCLI-331 to shape B now and A later, verifying probe() :405, ensure() :408/:410 and v0.11.0 :680-681 by ref. Under B, quest's status-flow gains closedStatus 'Closed' and resolutions, and terminalStatuses stays [Done]: shipped lore keeps working, and a Closed record reports statusNotInFlow. COUNTERPART: quest-cli QCLI-406 (opum-ai/quest-cli#385) is the later step A. It moves Closed into terminalStatuses and is BLOCKED on this task becoming the adapter floor consumers actually run. This task is therefore QCLI-406's prerequisite, not the next pair release's. Per opum-agent it keeps its queue place, after LCLI-622 phase 2. Criterion 4 was added for the tolerance rule and the version-mismatch drift message. The ~190 hardcoded 'Done' literals the ADR says are owed to classification are covered by criterion 1: measure before code, classify src/ and scripts/ separately from test fixtures, with a positive control.

SHAPE B MEASURED LIVE by quest-cli, not re-run here (2026-09-28). Published lore 0.11.0 against a quest built from opum-ai/quest-cli#386 head 00c6bbe (QCLI-331 shape B), through a logging quest shim. lore check: exit 0, 146 quest calls. lore tasks stories/audit-quest-cli-documentation-authority: exit 0, 10 calls, output byte-identical to the same command against quest 0.11.0. So probe() passes on published lore under B. The measurement is recorded as a comment on quest-cli#386. lore-cli's own reading (verifyManifest at quest.ts:724 only requires REQUIRED_COMMANDS; statusFlow at :676 passes when terminal is a subset of statuses) agrees. PRIORITY per opum-agent: this task gates quest-cli QCLI-406, so it must not slip behind LCLI-634 to 636.

AC1 MEASUREMENT, recorded BEFORE any source change (2026-09-28, worktree cut from origin/dev 163811bb, branch fix/LCLI-633-quest-terminal-statuses). Tool: /usr/bin/grep (BSD), not the harness ugrep shim, so ignored-by-VCS files are not skipped.

FILES READ: `find src scripts -type f | wc -l` = 139 (src 119, scripts 20). test/ read separately: `find test -type f | wc -l` = 159.

SEARCH (bare word, case-sensitive, classify after): `/usr/bin/grep -rnw Done src/ scripts/` -> 13 hits in 9 files (`-rlw` = 9), ALL in src/, 0 in scripts/. POSITIVE CONTROL: src/adapters/backlog.ts:1108 `DEFAULT_STATUS_FLOW = ["To Do", "In Progress", "Done"]` is a known literal site; the search must find it and does. (src/adapters/quest.ts carries ZERO bare-word Done: `/usr/bin/grep -cw Done src/adapters/quest.ts` = 0, so it cannot serve as the control.) Case-insensitive `-rniw done src/ scripts/` = 90; the lowercase hits (`-rnw done` = 76) were skimmed by file: the lore rollup vocabulary (reconcile.ts, schema.ts `todo|in-progress|done`), cutover phase `done` (tracker-cutover.ts, cutover-state.ts), shell loop keyword `done` and prose in scripts/*.sh and *.mjs, iterator `.done` (ladybug-driver.ts, agent-plugins.ts), and comments. None compares a quest task status.

CLASSIFICATION of the 13 src/ `Done` hits:
- Backlog backend default ladder (not quest): adapters/backlog.ts:1108 [1]
- Jira default ladder (not quest): commands/init.ts:2187 [1]
- Reader-facing example strings in hints/config templates: core/reconcile.ts:76, :98; core/scaffold.ts:207, :230 [4]
- Doc comments only: core/managed-block.ts:110; core/reconcile.ts:118, :147; commands/query.ts:212; commands/tasks.ts:116; config.ts:133 [6]
- Agent-bridge prose (out of scope per brief; it regenerates consumer bridges): core/agent-bridge.ts:230 [1]
LITERAL SITES treating "Done" as the only terminal quest status: 0.

THE LITERAL IS A FLOOR, NOT THE INVENTORY. The real hardcoding is POSITIONAL: one site plus the adapter that feeds it.
(1) src/core/reconcile.ts classify(): `index === statusFlow.length - 1` -> "terminal" is the only way a non-override status is terminal. For quest that is statuses[-1] = "Done".
(2) src/adapters/quest.ts statusFlow() (:676-682) parses terminalStatuses only to validate it, then DISCARDS it and returns `statuses`. The quest terminal set never reaches reconciliation.
Every quest completion decision lore makes funnels through that pair: reconcileStatus() is called only from commands/reconcile-shared.ts gatherReconciliation (lore check via check.ts:961/1061; lore sync via sync.ts:228-234). Searched `statusFlow\(|pausedStatus\(|reconcileStatus\(|validateReconcileInputs\(|terminalStatuses|closedStatus` across src/: no other consumer. lore tasks (commands/tasks.ts) echoes raw statuses and makes no completion decision; orphans.ts only notes that some quest versions drop terminal tasks from bulk list.
Consequence under QCLI-331 shape B (closedStatus "Closed", not in statuses): a task in Closed hits the not-in-flow throw in classify(), so lore check/sync fail with validation. Under shape A, if Closed were appended to statuses, positional classification would make Closed terminal and demote Done to "active" (a Story reads in-progress forever); if Closed stays out of statuses, the adapter today throws drift at quest.ts:680-681.

TEST FIXTURES (classified separately, not changed as data): `/usr/bin/grep -rnw Done test/` = 217 hits in 27 files (`-rlw` = 27); top: check.test.ts 35, reconcile.test.ts 27, sync.test.ts 19, reconcile-shared.test.ts 19, tasks.test.ts 17, managed-block.test.ts 14, quest-adapter.test.ts 13; 3 JSON fixture files under test/fixtures/backlog-json (6 hits) are pure data. These are fixture flows/statuses, not completion logic.

WIP HANDOFF (2026-09-28, stopped for a machine reboot). DONE: task started, plan recorded, AC1 measurement recorded as the note above and committed at 7ca599ea on branch fix/LCLI-633-quest-terminal-statuses BEFORE any source change. NOT DONE: no source or test file edited yet; AC2-AC5 all open. DESIGN SETTLED FROM READING (not yet coded): (a) add optional `terminalStatuses?(): Promise<readonly string[]>` to TrackerAdapter (src/adapters/tracker.ts, beside pausedStatus?); Backlog and Jira omit it and keep positional last-entry terminality. (b) quest.ts: parse closedStatus by key PRESENCE (Object.hasOwn), non-empty string else drift; accept terminalStatuses subset of statuses plus {closedStatus}; a terminal status outside both throws drift whose message and hint name a lore/quest version MISMATCH (not QUEST_VERSION_SET_HINT); new adapter method returns dedup [...terminalStatuses, closedStatus?]; statusFlow() keeps returning the statuses ladder. (c) core/reconcile.ts: reconcileStatus gains an optional terminalStatuses param; classify() checks it after overrides and before flow index, and when supplied the terminal set is authoritative (in-flow non-terminal: index 0 not-started, else active). (d) commands/reconcile-shared.ts: ReconcileConfig gains terminalStatuses; readReconcileConfig calls adapter.terminalStatuses?.(); gatherReconciliation threads it into reconcileStatus. Fallback: closedStatus absent -> terminalStatuses alone; backend without the method -> positional. EXACT NEXT STEP: implement (a)-(d), then tests test/lcli633-*.test.ts: adapter shape B, shape A, foreign terminal drift message; reconcile Closed complete vs In Progress not for check and sync; then gates (bun test, bun run typecheck, bun run lint, bun run lore check) and the mutation test reverting the closedStatus tolerance.

MUTATION PREDICTION (recorded before running). Mutant: revert the closedStatus tolerance in parseStatusFlow (src/adapters/quest.ts) — closedStatus ignored entirely, accepted set = statuses alone. Predicted red among the 17 tests in test/lcli633-quest-terminal-statuses.test.ts: (1) shape B test (terminalStatuses() loses Closed, toEqual [Done, Closed] fails), (2) criterion shape A test (Closed outside the ladder, no tolerance -> probe drift), (3) malformed-closedStatus test (no drift thrown -> probe resolves). Predicted green: foreign-terminal drift (the guard must survive), shape A with Closed in the ladder, dedupe test, predating-Quest fallback, all reconcile-engine tests, all reconcile-shared threading tests, both runCheck end-to-end tests.

MUTATION RESULT: prediction vs actual matched exactly. Mutant (closedStatus tolerance reverted in parseStatusFlow) ran against test/lcli633-quest-terminal-statuses.test.ts: 3 fail / 14 pass. Red = predicted red, one-for-one: shape B (terminal set lost Closed), criterion shape A (probe drift, Closed outside ladder), malformed-closedStatus (no drift thrown). Green = predicted green: foreign-terminal drift guard, shape A with Closed in the ladder, dedupe, predating-Quest fallback, all 5 reconcile-engine tests, all 3 reconcile-shared tests, both runCheck end-to-end tests. The mutant reddens exactly the closedStatus-dependent cases and leaves the foreign-drift guard intact. Fix restored afterward; suite back to 17/17 pass.
